```{r run-model-b, include=FALSE}
# Run base case for Model B (focused specification)
result_B <- run_basecase_for_structure(1, verbose = TRUE)

# Re-run with traces to compute LYs
trace_result <- model_fun(l_params_base, determpsa = "det", return_traces = TRUE)
traces <- trace_result$traces

# Compute discount factors for effects
v_dw_e <- 1 / (1 + dr)^(seq(0, time_horizon) / 52)

# Compute discounted LYs for each strategy from traces
ly_values <- sapply(names(traces), function(strat) {
  tr <- traces[[strat]]
  os <- tr$p_pf + tr$p_p  # alive = progression-free + progressed
  sum(os * v_dw_e * cl)
})
```

```{r build-cea-table, include=FALSE}
strategy_labels <- c(
  "control" = "Standard care",
  "crp" = "CRP-guided",
  "tmb_braf" = "TMB/BRAF-guided",
  "tlr" = "TLR-guided*"
)

icer_df <- as.data.frame(result_B$icer_obj)

# Add LYs column
icer_df$LYs <- ly_values[match(icer_df$Strategy, names(ly_values))]

# Build display table
display_df <- icer_df %>%
  mutate(
    Strategy_Label = strategy_labels[Strategy],
    Cost_fmt = sprintf("\u20AC%s", format(round(Cost), big.mark = ",")),
    LY_fmt = sprintf("%.2f", LYs),
    QALY_fmt = sprintf("%.2f", Effect),
    Inc_Cost_fmt = ifelse(is.na(Inc_Cost), "\u2014",
                          sprintf("\u20AC%s", format(round(Inc_Cost), big.mark = ","))),
    Inc_QALY_fmt = ifelse(is.na(Inc_Effect), "\u2014",
                          sprintf("%.2f", Inc_Effect)),
    ICER_fmt = case_when(
      Status %in% c("D", "ED") ~ "Dominated",
      is.na(ICER) & Status == "ND" ~ "\u2014",
      !is.na(ICER) ~ sprintf("\u20AC%s", format(round(ICER), big.mark = ",")),
      TRUE ~ "\u2014"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(Strategy_Label, Cost_fmt, LY_fmt, QALY_fmt,
         Inc_Cost_fmt, Inc_QALY_fmt, ICER_fmt)
```

```{r display-table}
kable(display_df,
      caption = "Table 4: Base-case cost-effectiveness results: overall MSS population (Model B)",
      format = "html",
      col.names = c("Strategy", "Cost (\u20AC)", "LYs", "QALYs",
                     "\u0394 Cost (\u20AC)", "\u0394 QALYs", "ICER"),
      align = c("l", rep("r", 6))) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE,
                font_size = 12) %>%
  footnote(
    general = c(
      "Costs and QALYs discounted at 4% per year. LYs = life-years. QALYs = quality-adjusted life-years.",
      "ICER = incremental cost-effectiveness ratio (\u20AC per QALY gained) versus next non-dominated alternative.",
      "Dominated = more costly and less effective than comparator.",
      "*TLR-guided evaluated under Models A and C only."
    ),
    general_title = "Notes: "
  )
```

```{r save-table, include=FALSE}
tables_dir <- here("tables")
if (!dir.exists(tables_dir)) {
  dir.create(tables_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

# Save raw numeric data
save_data <- icer_df %>%
  select(Strategy, Cost, LYs, Effect, Inc_Cost, Inc_Effect, ICER, Status)
names(save_data)[names(save_data) == "Effect"] <- "QALYs"

write.csv(save_data, file = here("tables", "table_4.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat("Table saved to:", here("tables", "table_4.csv"), "\n")
```

Table 4 has been saved to `tables/table_4.csv`.
